text:
jin: Canary note: deployed 'kernel-splitter-v1' to 3% fleet. Quick numbers on prod-like mix: p50 -18%, p99 -10%, cost -20%.

maya: nice. bench command and baseline?

jin: command: ./rbench --suite=hotpath_mix --seq=prod --iters=3000. baseline p50=62ms p99=210ms cost=1.0x, split p50=51ms p99=189ms cost=0.80x.

otto: any error spike or memory regression?

jin: no errors, ~+2% peak memory on a couple kernels but within margin.

maya: rollback plan?

jin: health probe watches p99 per frontier; if p99 > baseline*1.05 for 5m we flip to fallback-kernel and auto-roll back. Alerts to #runtime-canaries.

otto: Dedicated customers need changes?

jin: runtime default enables it. we'll add opt-out toggle in Dedicated console before GA.

maya: ramp proposal?

jin: 3% -> 10% (24h) -> 30% (48h) -> 100% with health gates and debug logs at 10% for 48h. I'll open rollout ticket and attach traces.

deploy-bot: canary started by jin at 2005004321, targets=22, traffic=3% -> monitoring: #runtime-canaries

maya: can you draft 1-line + slide for all-hands?

jin: yes, will post by EOD and share full 48h report here.
